title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Case Closure Reasons
content:
An orthodontic case under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders (Cascade Ortho Rider family) is closed for one of four reasons.

| Closure reason | When it is used |
|---|---|
| completed | the orthodontist reports appliance removal at the end of treatment |
| discontinued | treatment stops early |
| coverage ended | the rider terminates |
| lifetime maximum reached | the person's lifetime maximum is exhausted |

## Effect of a closure

- After closure, no further installment is paid.
- Payments already made for service periods that began while covered are not recovered, on a rider where discontinued treatment brings no recovery (every Cascade Ortho Rider).
- A case closed as "coverage ended" continues if, and only if, the rider is restored without a gap by a dental reinstatement. In that case the closure is superseded by a new establishment entry with the case origin "takeover", covering the remaining months.

### Points of judgement

**A rider ends while a case is open, and later the dental enrollment is reinstated without a gap, restoring the rider.** The "coverage ended" closure is superseded by a new takeover establishment for the remaining months, and the case continues.

**The rider ends and is never restored without a gap.** The case stays closed as "coverage ended", and no further installment is paid.
